## The problem

Instructors want interactive teaching tools but lack web-development skills.

## Approach

Instructor-led walkthrough of a reference app in 5 steps, then tiered lab shells (guided, stats dashboard, open challenge), deployment to Streamlit Cloud, and a quick-reference sheet.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Why it matters for a decision

Shows the ability to build analytic capacity in others by training colleagues to field their own tools.
:::

## Results

| Result | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Authored the workshop in the department org repo | git: lonespear 5 commits, usma-stats 1 (initial commit) |
| demo_facdev is the same app | diff --strip-trailing-cr shows identical app.py |

Every result above is traced to a script, log, or artifact in the repository. See [How I Check My Work](/approach.qmd).

## Limitations

- np.std (ddof=0) labeled 'Std dev'
- Stale line-number map in the app header
- Lab shells deliberately do not run until the blanks are filled

## Tools

Python, Streamlit, numpy, pandas, matplotlib
